title: REQ · Contribution-limit field is disabled because no endpoint exists
summary: Max contributions per player input is disabled with a note
description: The backend limit comes from config contribution.max_per_player and the create-round request has no such field, so the input must be disabled and labelled as configured on the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given AdminApp is authenticated, when it renders, then the Max contributions per player input is disabled.
Given it renders, then a note stating the limit is set in server configuration is visible and no request carries the limit value.

preserve: Label text Max contributions per player
